fragment: Normal oxygen saturation at sea level is 95–100%; it falls in severe pneumonia. Titrate the oxygen flow to a stable SpO₂ > 90% without wasting oxygen. context: Acute Otitis Media › 6.7.2 · high-dose amoxicillin · wicking › Watchful waiting (selected children)

Where follow-up is uncertain, treat with antibiotics.

context: Rheumatic Fever › 6.11 · 2015 Jones · naproxen · prophylaxis › Management

context: Step 1 · Hypoglycaemia › 7.4.1 · 10% glucose 50 ml · feed every 2 h › Diagnosis
fragment: Measure blood glucose immediately if it can be done quickly (e.g. Dextrostix). Hypoglycaemia = blood glucose < 3 mmol/L (< 54 mg/dl).
